To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the World Wide Web has four main characteristics that are dynamic, namely the size of the Web, its contents, its hyperlinks, and the information needs of its users.
Web dynamics and their ramifications to Web search engines have been studied and discussed in this paper.

1) Web dynamics, such as the growth of the Web, the dynamics of Web pages, the dynamics of hyperlink structures and users changing their searching needs, have significant impacts on Web search engines; 2) Web search engines have been developed to address the four factors, but there is still much to be done; and 3) the future development of Web engines should focus on improving the performance of Web search engines and providing personalized and adaptive search services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of Web-based information systems, with an emphasis on Web search engines.

the following questions: (1) What are the characteristics of Web dynamics and how do they affect the development of Web information retrieval? (2) What are the current techniques for addressing Web dynamics and what are their limitations?
how to design and build search engines that can effectively handle the Web dynamics and improve their performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Web dynamics are not only the challenges to the development of Web information retrieval systems, but also the opportunities.
the Web is dynamic in many ways, and that search engines need to be dynamic in many ways as well.
Web search engines have made tremendous progress, but they are still far away from a satisfactory state.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Web search engine research is still at its infancy.
the development of Web information retrieval (IR) systems should be based on a thorough understanding of the Web dynamics.
Web dynamics have been a driving force for the evolution of Web search engines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of Web information systems, such as Web search engines, should be based on a better understanding of Web dynamics.
Web search engines should be more dynamic and intelligent in the future to meet the challenges of Web dynamics.
Web dynamics will continue to be the main driving force for the development of future Web search engines.
